matching_and_selection_contract.adapter: app.infrastructure.locality_reference.LocalLocalityCatalogue enforces approved identity,owner scope,source/output pins,structure and attribution; no external runtime request.
matching_and_selection_contract.rules: Within selected country only; town boundary-trim/NFC/casefold and trimmed postcode strings intersect. Exact source names only; no alias invention, accent stripping, multilingual-name splitting, fuzzy matching, nearby/physical-location inference.
matching_and_selection_contract.pointer_validation: Exact source/release/source_record keys/types; server fetches canonical association, validates selected country and all supplied town/postcode values. Client matched flags, edited labels, stale/fabricated/inconsistent pointers are not trusted.

response_categories.single_match: Actual assessment then atomic201comparison or insufficient_coverage.

response_categories.no_match_or_outside_CH_LI: 200clarification_required/not_attempted; locality_reference_unknown, not an invalidity claim. Other approved countries remain valid choices.

matching_and_selection_contract.user_actions: Association selection alone and country/town/postcode editing send nothing. Labelled Continue with selected association captures fresh key/proof/payload. Location edits clear selected association and presentation. Ordinary Recovery retains original captured body; a fresh search creates new intent.
matching_and_selection_contract.minimal_persistence: Original text/independent span requirements and raw entered locality remain separate from normalized fields, explicit choice, one canonical association/pointer and server-derived release provenance. No candidate list is saved.
matching_and_selection_contract.provenance_field: interpretation.provenance.reference_versions.locality:{source,release,sha256,snapshot_at}, separate from country reference and captured client payload digest.
matching_and_selection_contract.identity_limits: source_record is meaningful only with this pinned release. ZIP_ID is postal identity; neither is a locality GUID. No cross-postcode equivalence or consolidation.
matching_and_selection_contract.qualification_boundary: Canonical selected association town/postcode guide actual applicability assessment, including postcode-only intent; raw fields remain unchanged in persistence. Matching does not establish provider coverage. Existing5S countrywide/unambiguously scoped evidence,freshness,rendering and essential textual requirements still govern qualification.
matching_and_selection_contract.presentation: Actual saved search_scope alone drives Matched in this reference wording,necessary labels and source credit; no verified delivery/user-location/universal-currentness claim. Recovery acknowledgement excludes saved scope/comparison replay.
